description:
A clinical neuropsychology lab needs to implement a P300 auditory oddball paradigm in PsychoPy Builder for EEG research. The P300 event-related potential (Sutton et al., 1965; Polich, 2007) is one of the most widely used biomarkers in clinical neuroscience for studying attention, working memory, and cognitive decline.

The paradigm uses two tones: a frequent 'standard' tone and an infrequent 'deviant' (oddball) tone. Participants press a button only when they detect the deviant. The P300 component appears approximately 300ms after deviant stimuli.

You must build the complete paradigm from scratch, creating both the Builder experiment and the conditions file.

Critical specifications (which you must implement correctly without step-by-step guidance):
- Standard tone: 1000 Hz, presented 80% of trials
- Deviant tone: 2000 Hz, presented 20% of trials
- The conditions file must contain exactly 300 rows total (240 standard + 60 deviant)
- Each row must include a 'tone_hz' column and a 'trigger_code' column (1=standard, 2=deviant) and an 'is_target' column (0/1)
- Tone duration: 20ms (a brief auditory pip)
- Jittered ISI: the inter-stimulus interval must vary randomly, conceptually 900-1100ms (can be set via the conditions file or code component)
- A code component must send a trigger at stimulus onset by printing the trigger code to the console/log (simulated parallel port output)
- At least 2 blocks of trials with a rest screen between them
- A final accuracy feedback screen showing hit rate and false alarm rate

Save the experiment to: /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/p300_oddball.psyexp
Save the conditions file to: /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/p300_conditions.csv
